name: customerio
description: Connect Customer.io to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Customer.io MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Customer.io to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with customer messaging data using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Customer.io workspace.
Find anything in Customer.io that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review customer messaging data in Customer.io.
